svg.text: OAuth flows, OIDC, SPA vs job – Visual Guide
Client1 · C03 extra · OIDC = OpenID Connect · SPA = Single Page App · PKCE = Proof Key for Code Exchange
Same IdP (Identity Provider); different grant per app type.
SPA = Single Page App. PKCE = Proof Key for Code Exchange. No secret in Angular.
User logs in at IdP (Identity Provider)
Background jobs CAN authenticate this way.
API as worker, not as user
OIDC = OpenID Connect. Need both: WHO logged in, and WHAT the API allows.
Implicit is deprecated. Hybrid is rare.
